label: Not
summary: Whether none of the conditions inside the block is true.
details: It turns the check around: the block passes only when the conditions inside fail. Vanilla mostly puts a single check in it, such as `exists = involved_activity` or `has_character_flag = ...`.

label: Number of accolades
summary: Compares how many accolades the character currently has with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_accolades < 3`. Vanilla compares it with the named value `max_accolades`.

label: Artifact kills
summary: Compares how many kills the artifact has been used in with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_artifact_kills >= 5`. It runs on an artifact.

label: Number of buildings
summary: Compares the number of ordinary buildings in the province with a number.
details: Buildings still under construction count. Duchy buildings and similar special buildings do not. Write it as a comparison, for example `num_buildings > 3`.

label: Number of character followers
summary: Compares how many characters follow the faith with a number.
details: It counts characters, not counties. Write it as a comparison, for example `num_character_followers >= 5`. It runs on a faith.

label: Number of county followers
summary: Compares how many counties follow the faith with a number.
details: It counts counties, not characters. Write it as a comparison, for example `num_county_followers > 0`, which is the most common form in vanilla (17 of 29 uses). It runs on a faith.

label: Number of county holdings
summary: Compares how many provinces of the county have a holding with a number.
details: It runs on a county title. Write it as a comparison, for example `num_county_holdings >= 2`.

label: Number of discovered innovations
summary: Compares how many innovations the culture has discovered with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_discovered_innovations > 20`. It runs on a culture.

label: Discovered innovations in an era
summary: Compares how many active discovered innovations the culture has in one given era with a number.
details: It can be written as a block with the era and the comparison, or in short form as `num_discovered_innovations_in_era:<era> > 15`. The game's documentation also shows comparing it with the same count of another culture. It runs on a culture.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The culture era to count innovations in.
fields.values: a culture era, for example culture_era_early_medieval

label: Number of domicile buildings
summary: Compares how many buildings have been built in the domicile with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_domicile_buildings >= 3`. It runs on a domicile.

label: Enemies killed
summary: Compares how many enemy troops this side of a battle has killed with a number.
details: It counts the troops killed on the opposing side. Write it as a comparison, for example `num_enemies_killed >= 500`. It runs on a combat side.

label: Entourage size
summary: Compares the size of the travel plan's entourage with a number.
details: Vanilla compares it with a cap value (`< $ENTOURAGE_CAP$`) or with small numbers. It runs on a travel plan.

label: Future phases
summary: Compares the number of phases the activity still has ahead with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_future_phases > 5`. It runs on an activity.

label: Leased titles
summary: Compares how many holdings the holy order has under lease with a number.
details: Vanilla compares it with fixed numbers and with `holy_order_barony_number_soft_threshold`, and once writes a plain number. It runs on a holy order.

label: Number of bad genetic traits
summary: Compares how many bad genetic traits the character has with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_of_bad_genetic_traits > 0`, or a plain number for an exact count. Vanilla also compares it with another character's count, as in `> scope:contester.num_of_bad_genetic_traits`.

label: Number of good genetic traits
summary: Compares how many good genetic traits the character has with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_of_good_genetic_traits >= 2`. Vanilla also compares it with the same character's bad genetic trait count.

label: Number of known languages
summary: Compares how many languages the character knows with a number.
details: Write it as a comparison, for example `num_of_known_languages > 1`. Vanilla often compares it with `language_soft_cap`.

label: Number of activity recurrer relations
summary: Compares how many scripted relations of the type activity recurrer the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. Vanilla uses it once, as `< 1`.

label: Number of antiquarian relations
summary: Compares how many scripted relations of the type antiquarian the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of best friends
summary: Compares how many best friend relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla mostly writes a plain `0`, and once `< 1`.

label: Number of blood brothers
summary: Compares how many blood brother relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla uses it with `0` and `>= 1`.

label: Number of bully relations
summary: Compares how many scripted relations of the type bully the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla uses it once, as `<= 0`, to check that the character has none.

label: Number of court physician relations
summary: Compares how many scripted relations of the type court physician the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of crushes
summary: Compares how many crush relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla writes it with values such as `<= 0`, `< 1`, `<= 2`, or a plain `0`.

label: Number of disciples
summary: Compares how many disciple relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla mostly compares it with `disciples_limit_value` or `> 0`. Once the compared number is written as a block with `value` and `add`, which gives a value plus an offset.

fields.name: value
fields.values: a number or script value, for example `scope:secondary_recipient.disciples_limit_value`

fields.name: add
fields.text: An amount added to the base number (a negative number subtracts).

label: Number of elders
summary: Compares how many elder relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla uses it with `> 0` and a plain `0`.

label: Number of event recurrer relations
summary: Compares how many scripted relations of the type event recurrer the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of favorite children

details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of fellow disciples

details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of friends

details: Vanilla mostly writes `< 2` (38 of 63 uses), or a plain `0`.

label: Number of grudges
summary: Compares how many grudge relations the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of guardians
summary: Compares how many guardian relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla mostly writes a plain `0` (19 of 22 uses).

label: Number of intrigue mentors
summary: Compares how many intrigue mentor relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla uses it with `0` and `<= 0`, to check that the character has none.

label: Number of intrigue students
summary: Compares how many intrigue student relations the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of lovers
summary: Compares how many lover relations the character has with a number.
details: Vanilla mostly writes `< 2` or `< 1`, or a plain `0`.

label: Number of mentors
summary: Compares how many mentor relations the character has with a number.
details: The game's documentation only says it counts scripted relations of this type. The vanilla data shows no use of it.

label: Number of nemeses

details: Vanilla uses it with `0` and `<= 0`, to check that the character has none.

label: Number of nursed children

label: Number of oaf relations
summary: Compares how many scripted relations of the type oaf the character has with a number.
